subject: general
question: The number of sides of a regular polygon whose sum of all interior angles is 2700° is:
solution:
Given:

The sum of all interior angles of a polygon = 2700°

Formula used:

Total number of diagonals of polygon = n(n – 3)/2

Sum of all interior angles of polygon = (n – 2) × 180° 

Here, n is the number of sides of the polygon

Calculation:

Sum of all interior angles of polygon = (n – 2) × 180° 

⇒ 2700° = (n – 2) × 180°

⇒ n = 17

∴ The answer is 17.
